features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with auth and domain engine
acceptance: FastAPI app starts and serves health endpoint
React frontend builds and loads
OIDC Keycloak auth flow configured
SQLite persistence with migrations
Docker compose runs backend, frontend, Keycloak
CI workflow runs backend/frontend tests

features.title: Decompiler output analysis engine
acceptance: Parse decompiler output into structured AST
Identify indirect calls (vtable, switch, JMP/PUSH patterns)
Resolve function targets from cross-references

features.title: VTable function call resolver (Issue #516)
acceptance: Detect vtable patterns in decompiler output
Resolve indirect calls to concrete function names
Display resolved calls in UI with navigation

features.title: Switch statement recovery (Issue #2628)
acceptance: Recognize jump-table switch patterns
Reconstruct switch cases from comparison chains
Render as switch in decompiler view

features.title: JMP-with-PUSH call recovery (Issue #5747)
acceptance: Detect PUSH+JMP call patterns
Recover return addresses for correct CFG
Render as proper call sites in decompiler

features.title: Cross-segment string recovery (Issue #4865)
acceptance: Scan all memory segments for string data
Associate string references in decompiler
Display strings inline in decompiler view

features.title: Scalable batch decompilation (Issue #2791)
acceptance: Parallel decompilation with work-stealing queue
Shared analysis cache across workers
Benchmark shows linear scaling to 16+ cores
